messages:
Mia (Design): quick copy nit on the Confirm modal when deleting a Dedicated pool. current: "This action will permanently delete the pool and its settings. Are you sure?"
Alex (Product): saw it in the release draft. what's the concern?
Mia (Design): it's ambiguous. users might think their models, logs, or hosted artifacts are deleted. also no undo mentioned.
Sam (PM): Dedicated pools remove config & reserved capacity only — good to avoid scaring customers.
Mia (Design): proposed replacement (heading + body):
```
Delete capacity
This will remove the pool configuration and any reserved capacity. Pinned model versions will be unlinked. Your hosted model artifacts and logs will NOT be deleted. You can undo this action for 30 seconds.
```
Jordan (Eng): accessibility nits: spell out time unit ("30 seconds"), and focus must land on Cancel by default. I'll add aria-label: "Confirm delete dedicated capacity" on the dialog.
Alex (Product): shorter heading OK? we use similar phrasing elsewhere so match other modals.
Mia (Design): changed heading to "Delete capacity" to match tone. kept explicit second sentence about what is NOT deleted.
Sam (PM): can we add a danger icon in the header for emphasis? red button is probably enough but icon helps scannability.
Jordan (Eng): doable. i'll include icon svg and implement focus + aria changes in the PR.
Mia (Design): snackbar copy for undo: "Deletion scheduled. You can undo this action for 30 seconds. Undo" — full sentence helps voiceover.
Alex (Product): looks good. i'll update the release note to: "Clarified delete capacity modal and added undo window."
Sam (PM): approved from PM side. :thumbsup:
Jordan (Eng): creating PR with modal copy, focus change, aria label, and snackbar text.
ui-bot: PR opened by @jordan: https://git.redwood/infer/pull/512 — includes copy + a11y + undo snackbar
Mia (Design): thanks! i'll review PR and test with VO/JA screenreaders tomorrow. :sparkles:
Alex (Product): moving to handoff. closing thread. :wave:
